html:
The Nguri are an Aboriginal people of southern Queensland, in country around the upper Warrego and Maranoa rivers.

Their neighbours on the map include the Gunggari to the east, the Bidjara to the north and the Wadjalang to the west. Pastoral runs spread into the region in the 1850s and 1860s. Little else is recorded about them as a separate group. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Nguri are an Aboriginal people of southern Queensland, in country around the upper Warrego and Maranoa rivers.
